notes: Unified actors register: organization | institution | initiative. FGP categories for website display. Source of truth — organizations.json is a derived compatibility view.

actors.name: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights
actors.description: African regional human-rights body relevant to youth protest, climate, and governance accountability cases.
aliases: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights

actors.name: AI for Good (AI Singapore)
actors.focus: inclusive AI literacy and workforce development
actors.description: AI Singapore's flagship initiative scaling inclusive AI education across ASEAN and beyond. Reached 100K+ beneficiaries across 14 countries. Runs the AI Ready ASEAN Youth Challenge across all 11 ASEAN member states, trains 200 Master Trainers, and convenes national policy dialogues on AI in Education. Partners include ASEAN Foundation, Google.org, UNDP, AWS, and Micron Foundation. Also runs the AI for Good Festival — a gamified AI literacy event with interactive booths, workshops, and hackathon-style showcases.
actors.mandate_type: national AI programme with regional reach

actors.name: Australian Parliamentary Group for Future Generations
actors.description: Cross-party parliamentary caucus supporting the Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill and a national Future Generations Commissioner.
aliases: Australian Parliamentary Group for Future Generations

actors.name: Balearic Law 10/2023 — Wellbeing for Present and Future Generations
actors.description: Spain's first subnational wellbeing-for-future-generations statute, born from a popular legislative initiative led by GOB Mallorca.

actors.name: British Group of the Inter-Parliamentary Union
actors.description: UK parliamentary branch of the IPU, relevant to youth representation, inter-parliamentary democracy, and future-generations work.
aliases: British Group of the Inter-Parliamentary Union

actors.name: California Youth Empowerment Commission
actors.description: California's statutory youth commission, using planning and budget scrutiny to institutionalize youth voice in state governance.

actors.name: CEPAL Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias
actors.description: UN ECLAC network promoting anticipatory governance and legislative foresight across Latin American parliaments. Member legislatures include Chile, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay, Paraguay, and Córdoba (Argentina). Partners with the UNU Future Generations Platform and delivers regional conferences, self-paced courses, and technical assistance.
aliases: CEPAL Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias
Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias
CEPAL Red de Comisiones de Futuro
Second Regional Conference of Parliamentary Futures Commissions

actors.name: Children's Commissioner for England
actors.description: Independent statutory advocate for children in England, increasingly engaging intergenerational fairness, democracy anxiety, and long-term wellbeing.

actors.name: Children's Commissioner for England
actors.description: Independent statutory advocate for children in England, increasingly engaging intergenerational fairness, democracy anxiety, and long-term wellbeing.

actors.name: CJEU Ilva Industrial Emissions Climate Ruling (2024)
actors.description: CJEU Grand Chamber judgment in C.Z. and Others v Ilva SpA (C-626/22) requiring assessment of harmful pollutants and suspension of high-risk industrial plants under the Industrial Emissions Directive and EU Charter environmental rights.
aliases: Court of Justice of the European Union Ilva

actors.name: Climate Change Authority (Australia)
actors.description: Independent body advising on Australia's emissions targets under the Climate Change Act 2022.

actors.name: Climate Change Committee (UK)
actors.description: Independent statutory body under the Climate Change Act 2008 advising on emissions targets and long-term decarbonisation pathways.

actors.name: Colombia Constitutional Court T-390/25 (Awá Future Generations)
actors.description: Constitutional Court Sentencia T-390/25 protecting Awá indigenous people including rights of future generations over Trans-Andean pipeline oil contamination.

actors.name: Comisión de Desafíos del Futuro, Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Senado de Chile)
actors.description: Standing Senate commission (since 2012) promoting strategic foresight and anticipatory governance in Chilean legislation. Co-requested the Inter-American Court climate advisory opinion AO-32/25 with Colombia and participates in CEPAL's parliamentary futures network.
aliases: Comisión de Desafíos del Futuro, Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación (Senado de Chile)
Senado de Chile Comisión de Desafíos del Futuro

actors.name: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso de la República de Colombia)
actors.description: Member of CEPAL's parliamentary futures network. Colombia co-requested Inter-American Court advisory opinion AO-32/25 and hosts significant climate litigation recognizing future generations (e.g., Amazon youth lawsuit, T-390/25 Awa case).
aliases: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso de la República de Colombia)

actors.name: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso Nacional del Paraguay)
actors.description: Parliamentary futures commission member of CEPAL's regional network. Paraguay also maintains a Congressional Futures Commission in the lower house (since 2022) as part of the Latin American parliamentary foresight movement.
aliases: Comisión de Futuro (Congreso Nacional del Paraguay)

actors.name: Comisión de Futuro (Senado de México)
actors.description: Senate futures commission participating in CEPAL's Red de Comisiones de Futuro Parlamentarias.
aliases: Comisión de Futuro y Gobernanza Anticipatoria
Senado de México Comisión de Futuro

actors.name: Comisión de Futuro Parlamentaria (Legislatura de Córdoba)
actors.description: First subnational parliamentary futures commission in Latin America, established May 2025 via Resolution 42800. Mandated to institutionalize strategic and anticipatory perspective in provincial legislation with technical support from COPEC and CEPAL.
aliases: Comisión de Futuro Parlamentaria (Legislatura de Córdoba)
Legislatura de Córdoba Comisión de Futuro

actors.name: Comisión Especial de Futuros (Asamblea General del Uruguay)
actors.description: Special parliamentary commission created under Law 19.509 (2017) to address strategic long-term issues including climate, AI, education, and demographic change through anticipatory governance and collective intelligence methods. Chaired by Senator Blanca Rodríguez as of May 2026.
aliases: Comisión Especial de Futuros (Asamblea General del Uruguay)

actors.name: Comisión para el Bienestar de las Generaciones Presentes y Futuras (Illes Balears)
actors.description: Independent consultative body under Balearic Law 10/2023 — Spain's first subnational wellbeing-for-future-generations statute. Oversees wellbeing impact assessments on legislation, budgets, and public planning; born from a popular legislative initiative led by GOB.
aliases: Comisión para el Bienestar de las Generaciones Presentes y Futuras (Illes Balears)

actors.name: Comissão Senado do Futuro (Senado Federal do Brasil) — dissolved 2023
actors.description: Senate Futures Commission (2013–2023) examining long-term strategic issues including technology and climate. Extinct under Senate Resolution 14/2023 (June 2023), transformed into the Comissão de Defesa da Democracia. Brazil's CEPAL network participation continues through other chambers, but the dedicated Senate futures mandate ended.
aliases: Comissão Senado do Futuro (Senado Federal do Brasil) — dissolved 2023

actors.name: Consejo para la Planificación Estratégica de Córdoba (CoPEC)
actors.description: Provincial strategic planning council providing technical assistance to Córdoba's parliamentary Future Commission and co-organizing CEPAL training on demographic ageing and legislative foresight.
aliases: Consejo para la Planificación Estratégica de Córdoba (CoPEC)
Consejo para la Planificación Estratégica de Córdoba

actors.name: Conselho do Futuro (Plataforma Crescimento Sustentável)
actors.description: Youth-led council within the Sustainable Growth Platform producing policy papers and engaging decision-makers on intergenerational fairness principles. Fills part of the institutional gap where Portugal lacks a statutory future-generations commissioner.

actors.name: Constitutional Court of Colombia
actors.description: Colombia's constitutional court; landmark climate, Indigenous, and future generations jurisprudence including T-390/25 Awá ruling and rights-of-nature precedents.

actors.name: Constitutional Court of Hungary
actors.description: Hungary's constitutional court, relevant to child-protection and intergenerational-justice constitutional disputes.

actors.name: Constitutional Court of Korea
actors.description: South Korea's constitutional court, which imposed a deadline for climate-law reform to protect future generations.

actors.name: Corte Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (Inter-American Court of Human Rights)
actors.description: Regional human rights court whose Advisory Opinion AO-32/25 (May 2025) recognized a right to a healthy climate and affirmed intergenerational equity as essential to climate rights across 20 OAS member states.
aliases: Corte Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (Inter-American Court of Human Rights)

actors.name: Council on Environmental Quality (CEQ)
actors.description: White House council overseeing NEPA environmental review for federal actions.

actors.name: Court of Justice of the European Union
actors.description: Supreme court of the European Union interpreting EU law, including environmental and climate obligations under the EU Charter and directives.
aliases: Court of Justice of the European Union

actors.name: Court of King's Bench of Alberta
actors.description: Alberta's superior court, relevant to privacy, AI, and constitutional litigation with long-term implications.
aliases: Court of King's Bench of Alberta

actors.name: Court of Session, Scotland
actors.description: Scotland's supreme civil court, central to environmental and climate litigation with long-term consequences.

actors.name: Democracy Development Program

actors.name: Digital Safety Commission of Canada
actors.focus: online safety and AI chatbot duties for children
actors.description: Proposed federal regulator under Bill C-34 for child online safety, AI chatbots, transparency, and enforcement duties.

actors.name: EFTA Court
actors.description: The EFTA Court interprets EEA law, including climate-impact and lifecycle-emissions standards affecting future generations.
aliases: Court of Justice of the European Free Trade Association

actors.name: eSafety Commissioner (Australia)
actors.description: Australia's online-safety regulator, now enforcing the under-16 social-media minimum-age obligation and platform compliance duties.

actors.name: EU Bioeconomy Youth Participatory Platform
actors.description: Permanent youth participatory platform proposed by EESC building on the EU Bioeconomy Youth Ambassadors initiative for bioeconomy strategy governance.

actors.name: EU Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport
actors.description: First explicit EU-level institutional mandate for intergenerational fairness, held by Commissioner Glenn Micallef from 2024.
aliases: EU Commissioner for Intergenerational Fairness, Youth, Culture and Sport

actors.name: EU Strategy for Intergenerational Fairness
actors.description: European Commission flagship strategy (March 2026) mainstreaming intergenerational fairness across EU policy areas, citing member-state models including Malta, Wales, and Spain.

actors.name: European Commission
actors.description: Executive branch of the European Union, responsible for proposing legislation and implementing decisions including the EU Strategy for Intergenerational Fairness.

actors.name: European Court of Human Rights
actors.description: The Council of Europe court for human-rights cases, including climate and environmental rights claims.

actors.name: European Parliament
actors.focus: EU legislative scrutiny and democratic oversight
actors.description: Directly elected EU legislature, a major venue for youth, platform, digital-rights, and climate governance signals.

actors.name: Federal Court of Australia
actors.description: Australia's federal trial court, hearing major public-law and climate-related appeals.

actors.name: Finance Commission
actors.description: India's constitutional finance commission, relevant to intergenerational taxation, devolution, and fiscal fairness debates.

actors.name: Future Generations Commissioner for Wales
actors.description: Independent statutory role under the Well-being of Future Generations (Wales) Act 2015. Acts as guardian for future generations' interests in Wales, monitoring public bodies and issuing recommendations.

actors.name: GOB (Grup Balear d'Ornitologia i Defensa de la Naturalesa)
actors.description: Balearic environmental NGO that led the popular legislative initiative (ILP) resulting in Law 10/2023 on wellbeing for present and future generations — the first successful citizens' initiative of its kind in Spain.
aliases: GOB (Grup Balear d'Ornitologia i Defensa de la Naturalesa)

actors.name: Guardian of Future Generations (Malta)
actors.description: Statutory commission under Malta's Sustainable Development Act (Cap. 521, Article 8) safeguarding intergenerational and intragenerational sustainable development. Chairperson and four members appointed by the Prime Minister after Opposition consultation. Advisory powers include policy review, impact-assessment scrutiny, public consultations, and information requests from government entities. Cited in the EU Intergenerational Fairness Strategy (March 2026) as a member-state institutional model.

actors.name: Gulbenkian De Hoje Para Amanhã
actors.description: Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation programme on present and future generations, supporting Portuguese dialogue on long-term governance and intergenerational fairness.

actors.name: Hawaii Office of Environmental Quality Control (OEQC)
actors.description: Administers Hawaii Environmental Policy Act reviews with constitutional intergenerational mandate.
aliases: Hawaii Office of Environmental Quality Control (OEQC)
Hawaii Office of Environmental Quality Control

actors.name: High Court of Australia
actors.description: Australia's apex court, central to constitutional and intergenerational rights litigation.

actors.name: High Court of Kenya at Nairobi
actors.description: Kenyan High Court forum for rights and capacity cases, including disability and child-rights litigation.
aliases: High Court of Kenya at Nairobi

actors.name: High Court of South Africa
actors.description: South Africa's High Court, important for child-rights, climate, and public-interest litigation.

actors.name: House of Lords Select Committee on Intergenerational Fairness and Provision

Lords Select Committee on Intergenerational Fairness and Provision

actors.name: Milieudefensie / Amsterdam District Court

actors.name: Oficina Nacional de Prospectiva y Estrategia (ONPE)
actors.description: Spanish government office coordinating the España 2050 long-term strategy, cited by the EU Intergenerational Fairness Strategy as a member-state model for institutionalizing strategic foresight in national governance.

actors.name: Pacific Islands Students Fighting Climate Change (PISFCC)

actors.name: Valutazione di Impatto Generazionale (VIG)

actors.name: Well-being of Future Generations (Wales) Act 2015
actors.description: Landmark Welsh legislation requiring public bodies to pursue sustainable development through seven well-being goals and five ways of working. Global reference model for future generations law.

actors.name: Wellbeing and Sustainable Development (Scotland) Bill

aliases: Scotland Wellbeing and Sustainable Development Bill

actors.name: Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill [HL] (UK)
actors.description: Lord Bird's private member's bill inspired by the Wales Act. Proposed UK wellbeing goals, a Commission for Future Generations, mandatory future-generations impact assessments, and extended OBR intergenerational reporting. Last progressed in 2021–22; dormant from 2022–26.
aliases: Lord Bird Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill
UK Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill

actors.name: Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill 2025 (Australia)
actors.description: Private member's bill introduced by Dr Sophie Scamps MP, modelled on Wales' Well-being of Future Generations Act. Proposed a Federal Wellbeing Framework, Future Generations Commissioner, and intergenerational wellbeing duty for public bodies. Lapsed in the House of Representatives in 2025.
aliases: Australian Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill
Sophie Scamps Wellbeing of Future Generations Bill
